_comment: Written by the repo template from includes/secrets.jinja (ADR 0003); refreshed by copier update. Names and rules only, never values.

secrets.if_missing: the Claude review job passes with a warning and reviews nothing
secrets.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
secrets.rotation: yearly (the token expires after 1 year) or on leak

secrets.if_missing: the SonarQube MCP server doesn't start in local Claude Code sessions
secrets.name: SONARQUBE_TOKEN

secrets.if_missing: the weekly template update check fails
secrets.name: TEMPLATE_READ_TOKEN
secrets.rotation: fine-grained PAT, contents:read on the template repo, ≤ 1 year

secrets.if_missing: the app can't call a model
secrets.name: Model API keys

secrets.if_missing: the nightly evals run against the mock model only
secrets.name: EVAL_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
